description: Open the AI inbox: a webhook kept for your AI instead of sent anywhere, receiving every event: your connected LinkedIn accounts, your shared inbox and your X account. Opened for you when an AI connection is created; calling it again answers the same inbox. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /linkedin/webhooks/inbox, group webhooks.
